term.label: chromatin_regulatory_region

definition.text: A region of a chromosome where regulatory events occur, including epigenetic modifications. These epigenetic modifications can include nucleosome modifications and post-replicational DNA modifications.

comments: Added by Dave to be consistent with other ontologies updated with GREEKC initiative.
